notes: 2026-09-15 specification audit completed; 2026-09-16 review repair added untrusted-PDF isolation, bounded image decoding, durable standalone-delete recovery and a synchronized admin descriptor/content renderer handoff. D-C1 remains public-only remote HTTP/HTTPS with no private-network allowlist or fallback. Notes owns note-specific receipt/idempotency; content owns generic quarantine lifecycle state without duplicating notes receipt. Implementation approval was granted after the final-plan review; content roots, standalone manifest primitives, and the shared PDF renderer/runtime seam are now in place, while delete-flow integration, remote fetch, tar.gz, provider migration, and delivery evidence remain open.
